t: Seven at One Swat: Taming AI-Generated Code Sprawl
s: This article details a developer's strategy to manage AI-induced code complexity in the Pipulate project, advocating for developer-centric design, Git branching, and the 'Rule of 7' to maintain simplicity and control.
